_comment: Google Cloud Service Account Configuration Template for BigQuery
_instructions: 2. Create a service account with BigQuery permissions
3. Create a JSON key for the service account and download it
5. Replace ALL placeholder values with your actual service account key values
6. NEVER commit googleaccount.json to git (it's in .gitignore)
7. Remove the _PLACEHOLDER suffix from the type field when pasting real credentials
_note: When you paste your downloaded service account key, remove all _PLACEHOLDER suffixes. The actual key from Google will have the correct field values without any placeholder markers.
